notes: JPN is the sole semantic and structural authority; MLG_CN/ENG are auxiliary evidence only.
Coverage is contiguous for logical unique_index 0-481; multiline CSV rows were handled by logical unique_index, never physical line number.
Row identity is bound strictly by unique_index + jpn_text. previous_jpn_text and next_jpn_text are context only and are not used to infer current-row identity.

Shared/deduplicated JPN titles and descriptions were preserved without inventing repeated logical rows; repaired boundaries include the equipment-retrieval block in part4 and the Fulton-recovery block in part6.
The part6/part7 boundary was rechecked directly against the source CSV: 298 is EXTRA OPS 034 Claymore title, 299 is its Cloud Forest description, and 300 is EXTRA OPS 061 Dead Man's Treasure title.
JPN color controls and source layout were preserved; auxiliary-added controls such as <I=CPY> around CAPCOM copyright lines were rejected.
Literal copyright text ©CAPCOM CO., LTD., significant fullwidth indentation, embedded blank lines, source ellipses and meaningful trailing/newline layout are preserved.
The shared interrogation description is represented once at unique_index 439, with DEMO 22/21/20 titles at 438/440/441 as dictated by JPN deduplication; 尋問 is localized as 审讯 and 独房 as 牢房.

Auxiliary semantic conflicts such as Fulton title duplication, ITEM RUNNER/cardboard substitution, target-count mismatches, time-penalty changes and missing failure conditions were rejected in favor of JPN.
